program:
PARAMS = {
    "gmid1": (14.0, 10.0, 18.0),     # diff pair efficiency
    "L1":    (0.8, 0.3, 2.0),        # diff pair length
    "Itail": (14e-6, 8e-6, 40e-6),   # first-stage tail current
    "L3":    (1.0, 0.5, 2.0),        # PMOS mirror / 2nd-stage PMOS length
    "gmid3": (10.0, 7.0, 14.0),      # PMOS mirror and M6 gm/Id (matched)
    "I6":    (80e-6, 30e-6, 150e-6), # second-stage current
    "Lb":    (1.0, 0.5, 2.0),        # NMOS bias mirror length
    "Cc":    (1.0e-12, 0.5e-12, 2.5e-12),
    "kRz":   (1.5, 0.8, 3.0),        # Rz = kRz/gm6
}

def design(p, lut, spec):
    cl = spec.get("cl", 2e-12)
    iref = spec.get("iref", 10e-6)
    It = p["Itail"]
    I1 = It / 2.0
    I6 = p["I6"]
    gmidb = 12.0

    # Bias mirrors: same gm/Id and L, currents scale by W
    mb = lut.size("n", gmidb, p["Lb"], iref, vds=0.6)
    m5 = lut.size("n", gmidb, p["Lb"], It, vds=0.25)
    m7 = lut.size("n", gmidb, p["Lb"], I6, vds=0.9)

    # Differential pair
    m1 = lut.size("n", p["gmid1"], p["L1"], I1, vds=0.5, vsb=0.25)

    # PMOS mirror load and second-stage PMOS (same gm/Id and L)
    m3 = lut.size("p", p["gmid3"], p["L3"], I1, vds=1.1)
    m6 = lut.size("p", p["gmid3"], p["L3"], I6, vds=0.9)

    Cc = p["Cc"]
    Rz = p["kRz"] / m6.gm

    n = Netlist("vinp vinn vout vdd vss ibias")
    # Bias
    n.dev("MB0", "ibias", "ibias", "vss", "vss", mb)
    n.dev("M5", "tail", "ibias", "vss", "vss", m5)
    n.dev("M7", "vout", "ibias", "vss", "vss", m7)
    # First stage: vinn on diode side, vinp on output side (non-inverting overall)
    n.dev("M1", "d1", "vinn", "tail", "vss", m1)
    n.dev("M2", "n1", "vinp", "tail", "vss", m1)
    n.dev("M3", "d1", "d1", "vdd", "vdd", m3)
    n.dev("M4", "n1", "d1", "vdd", "vdd", m3)
    # Second stage
    n.dev("M6", "vout", "n1", "vdd", "vdd", m6)
    # Miller compensation with nulling resistor
    n.R("RZ", "n1", "cz", Rz)
    n.C("CC", "cz", "vout", Cc)

    # Predictions
    A1 = m1.gm / (m1.gds + m3.gds)
    A2 = m6.gm / (m6.gds + m7.gds)
    gain_db = db(A1 * A2)
    ugbw = m1.gm / (2 * PI * Cc)
    c1 = m6.cgg + m3.cdd + m1.cdd
    den = 2 * PI * (c1 * Cc + cl * (Cc + c1) + c1 * cl)
    p2 = m6.gm * Cc / den if den > 0 else m6.gm / (2 * PI * cl)
    pmir = m3.gm / (2 * PI * 2 * m3.cgg)
    wz_inv = Cc * (Rz - 1.0 / m6.gm)
    fz = 1.0 / (2 * PI * wz_inv) if wz_inv > 0 else 1e12
    pm = 90 - math.degrees(math.atan(ugbw / p2)) - math.degrees(math.atan(ugbw / pmir)) \
         + math.degrees(math.atan(ugbw / fz))
    slew = min(It / Cc, I6 / (cl + Cc))
    power = 1.8 * (iref + It + I6)

    return n, {"gain_db": gain_db, "ugbw": ugbw, "pm": pm, "slew": slew, "power": power}
